in_arabic.name: Kiram
in_arabic.long_meaning: Kiram هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A precious and valuable gem, symbolizing beauty, wealth, and nobility. Derived from the Arabic root 'karamah', meaning 'generosity' and 'nobility'.

in_urdu.name: Kiram
